reuse.why: Implements the flag inside the existing guardBankAccountLink wrapper and link.assertBankAccountNotLinked check, so every provider's link handler gets it, and extracts the unlink field-clearing into clearAccountLink shared with unlinkAccount.

duplication.why: The unlink field reset that would otherwise be copied is extracted once and reused by unlinkAccount and the replace path.

placement.why: Link rules stay in accounts/link.ts and the orchestration in the guard wrapper in accounts/app.ts, matching the tree's layering.

scope.why: Only the link guard, the shared clear helper, the param type and tests change.

maintainability.why: Clean and central, though assertBankAccountNotLinked now returns the holder id instead of only asserting, so its name no longer matches its role, and its doc says null while it returns undefined.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All link handlers still go through guardBankAccountLink; unlinkAccount and the replace path share clearAccountLink.
